itineraries.title: Cary Halloween Friday: Scary Wildlife Walk, Farm Fun Park, Pumpkin Flotilla, Haunted Walk
itineraries.theme: A full Cary Friday: a naturalist walk on 'scary' wildlife at Downtown Cary Park, an afternoon at the Phillips Farms fall fun park, then jack-o'-lanterns floating on Bond Park lake and the Cary Teen Council haunted walk
itineraries.drive_time: About 20 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Cary via I-40 W / Walnut St; Phillips Farms is about 20 min northwest of downtown Cary; Bond Park is about 15 min from Phillips Farms
itineraries.cost_range: Wildlife walk free; Phillips Farms $22 per person (ages 2+); flotilla free; haunted walk $5; about $35-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny, mild Friday (44°F at 8 AM, 69°F by 3 PM, about 60°F at 7 PM). Start with the free 8 AM 'Bats, Bugs and Beasts' walk at Downtown Cary Park, then breakfast at Peck & Plume in the park. After lunch downtown, spend mid-afternoon at the Phillips Farms fall fun park (corn maze, wagon rides, pumpkin patch). Move to Bond Park at 5 PM for the Pumpkin Flotilla, with food trucks for dinner, then walk the Haunted Walk on the Bond Park Challenge Course from 7 PM.

morning.title: Bats, Bugs and Beasts
morning.location: DCP Guest Services, 327 S. Academy St., Cary, NC 27511
morning.notes: 8-9 AM. A naturalist walk with DCP horticulturist Patrick McMillan on animals and plants with a 'scary reputation'. Meets at Downtown Cary Park Guest Services. Register: http://wncarypark.com/things-to-do/calendar/r_ENVI0061_021. It is about 44°F at 8 AM; bring a jacket.

afternoon.title: Phillips Farms Fall Family Fun Park
afternoon.location: Phillips Farms of Cary, 6800 Good Hope Church Road, Cary, NC 27519
afternoon.notes: Open 3-6 PM on Friday. Corn maze, wagon and cow train rides, mega slide, petting zoo, pumpkin patch. Admission $22 per person ages 2 and up, paid at the gate (no online tickets). Info: https://www.phillipsfarmsofcary.com/family-fun-park. Leave by about 4:40 PM for Bond Park.

evening.title: Pumpkin Flotilla 2026
evening.location: Fred G. Bond Metro Park and Boathouse, 190 Bond Park Drive, Cary, NC 27513
evening.notes: 5-7 PM. Jack-o'-lanterns float across the lake at sunset (about 6:25 PM). Live music, food trucks and boat rentals while you wait. Event page: https://www.carync.gov/Home/Components/Calendar/Event/26114/1636?curm=10&cury=2026

evening.title: Haunted Walk Night 1
evening.location: Bond Park Challenge Course, 801 High House Rd, Cary, NC 27513
evening.notes: Starts 7 PM (end time estimated at 10:30 PM). Run by the Cary Teen Council; light concessions on site. Tickets: https://www.carync.gov/Home/Components/Calendar/Event/25558/1636?curm=5&cury=2026. Same park as the flotilla.

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (sourdough, beet hummus, avocado, whipped ricotta, za'atar)
food.notes: 301 S Academy St, Cary NC 27511, in Downtown Cary Park beside the morning walk. Own site: weekday breakfast 7-10:30 AM. Own breakfast menu: Avocado Toast $14 and Peck & Plume Porridge $11 are labeled V. No breakfast item is labeled vegan, so no vegan dish was verified.

201 W Chatham St, Cary NC (address confirmed on its own site). Pakistani and Indian. Its site shows no menu text (ordering page did not load), so no vegan or vegetarian dish or price was verified, and Friday lunch hours were not confirmed. Call (919) 377-8794. Fallback with a verified menu: Peck & Plume's weekday lunch (11 AM-2 PM) lists Mayton Bowl $13 (VG) and Warm Harvest Grain Bowl $14 (V).

food.place: Food trucks at the Pumpkin Flotilla
food.notes: The flotilla listing says food trucks will be on site; it does not name the trucks. No vegan or vegetarian dish was verified. The haunted walk also sells light concessions.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and cold at the start (44°F). Do the full walk, then eat on the Peck & Plume patio.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (0%). If plans change, browse indoors at Peck & Plume and the Downtown Cary Park guest services area.

alternatives.good_weather: 69°F and sunny. Do the corn maze first while the sun is high.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If it does rain, the farm may close; go instead to 'Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!' at The Cary Theater (2 PM, event a148960c304d, price unknown).

alternatives.good_weather: Partly cloudy, about 60°F at 7 PM and 56°F by 9 PM. Bring a layer for the lakeside wait.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, swap to Zombiepalooza, the free zombie short-film night at the Downtown Cary Park Great Lawn Pavilion (6-10 PM, event 3716468982b7).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:30 AM for the 8 AM walk (I-40 W to Walnut St, about 20 min).
Downtown Cary Park and Peck & Plume share a block on S Academy St; park once in downtown Cary for the morning and lunch.
Phillips Farms takes payment only at the gate. Info: https://www.phillipsfarmsofcary.com/family-fun-park
Bond Park: park at the boathouse lot (190 Bond Park Dr) for the flotilla. The Challenge Course is on the High House Rd side (801 High House Rd) of the same park.
Haunted walk tickets: https://www.carync.gov/Home/Components/Calendar/Event/25558/1636?curm=5&cury=2026
Drive back to Raleigh from Bond Park takes about 25 min.

itineraries.title: Raleigh Halloween Saturday: Spellbound at Mordecai, Dracula Matinee, Horror Book Fest, Zombie Walk
itineraries.theme: Haunted Raleigh history and Halloween comedy: a haunted tour and pumpkin decorating at Mordecai, the Dracula comedy at Theatre Raleigh, then a horror book fair and the downtown zombie walk
itineraries.drive_time: All stops are inside Raleigh. Mordecai to Theatre Raleigh is about 15 min via Capital Blvd / Old Wake Forest Rd; Theatre Raleigh back to downtown is about 15 min
itineraries.cost_range: Mordecai events free; Dracula $39-$57; book fest and zombie walk free; about $45-$75 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny, cool Saturday (54°F at 10 AM, 63-65°F in the afternoon, about 56°F at 8 PM). Start at Mordecai Historic Park with Spellbound (pumpkin decorating, makers market, costumed characters) and the free Haunted Mordecai tour. Lunch at The Fiction Kitchen, a vegan restaurant, then see the 2 PM matinee of 'Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors'. After an early dinner at Irregardless, browse the free Fiendish Horror Book Fest at the Longleaf Hotel and join the Raleigh Zombie Walk from Moore Square.

morning.title: Spellbound at Mordecai 2026
morning.location: Mordecai Historic Park, 1 Mimosa St., Raleigh, NC 27604
morning.notes: 10 AM-2 PM. Decorate a pumpkin to take home, shop handmade goods and treats, meet costumed characters. Info: https://raleighnc.gov/parks-and-recreation/events/spellbound-mordecai

morning.title: Haunted Mordecai
morning.location: Mordecai Historic Park Visitor Center, 1101 Wake Forest Road, Raleigh, NC 27604
morning.notes: 10:30-11:30 AM. Tour of the park's haunted history, part of its 10-year celebration. Free ticket on Eventbrite: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/haunted-mordecai-tickets-2003255445965

afternoon.title: Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors
afternoon.location: Theatre Raleigh (De Ann S. Jones Theatre), 6638 Old Wake Forest Rd., Raleigh, NC 27616
afternoon.notes: 2 PM matinee (end time estimated at 4 PM). Comic take on Bram Stoker's Dracula. Tickets: https://theatreraleigh.ludus.com/show_page.php?show_id=200496374

evening.title: The Fiendish Horror Book Fest (FREE!)
evening.location: The Longleaf Hotel and Lounge, 300 North Dawson Street, Raleigh, NC 27603
evening.notes: 6-9 PM. Horror books and their authors. Free ticket: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/the-fiendish-horror-book-fest-free-tickets-1999094583714

evening.title: Raleigh Zombie Walk 2026
evening.location: Moore Square, 225 E Martin St, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: Gathers at 6:45 PM (end time estimated). Family-friendly costumed walk that starts and ends in Moore Square. Free registration: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/raleigh-zombie-walk-2026-tickets-2002924967495. Moore Square is about a 15-min walk from the Longleaf Hotel.

food.notes: 219 E. Franklin St, Raleigh NC 27604, about 0.5 mi from Mordecai. Own site: Saturday 8 AM-4 PM. The site lists no menu items, so no vegan or vegetarian dish or price was verified; ask at the counter.

2431-103 Crabtree Blvd, Raleigh (moved from S Dawson St). Own site: Saturday lunch 11:30 AM-2:30 PM and describes its food as 'thoughtfully prepared vegan cuisine'. Own lunch menu: Tofu Banh Mi $16, Black Bean + Butternut Quesadilla $15. Dishes are not individually labeled vegan; the quesadilla lists mozzarella without saying it is plant-based, so confirm with staff. About 15 min to Theatre Raleigh; leave by 1:35 PM.

901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603. Own site: Saturday dinner 4:30-10 PM. Own dinner menu: Mujaddara $19 (VG, GFO); Eggplant Tower $17 (VEG, GF). Book a 4:45 PM table; the Longleaf Hotel is about 5 min away by car.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and 54°F at 10 AM, warming to about 63°F by 1 PM.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (0%). If needed, go to Carrie Williford's 'Please Don't Scare the Ghost' reading at Quail Ridge Books (10:30 AM, event a1c5ef3663ba, free).

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly clear, about 59°F at 7 PM and 56°F by 8 PM. Sunset is about 6:25 PM.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, stay at the indoor book fest, or take the Haunted Trolley Tour from Mordecai (7 PM, $15, event f30c4a007c74; book at https://raleighnc.gov/parks-and-recreation/events/haunted-trolley-tour-0).

practical_notes: Arrive at Mordecai by 9:50 AM. Park on the street around Mimosa St / Wake Forest Rd.
Book Dracula ahead: https://theatreraleigh.ludus.com/show_page.php?show_id=200496374. Theatre Raleigh is in North Raleigh (6638 Old Wake Forest Rd), not downtown; it has a parking lot.
The Fiction Kitchen recommends reserving; its site links online ordering at https://order.toasttab.com/online/fiction-kitchen.
Evening: park once in a downtown deck and walk between the Longleaf Hotel (300 N Dawson St) and Moore Square.
Costumes are encouraged at the zombie walk; it is free but asks you to register on Eventbrite.

itineraries.title: Hillsborough Saturday: Historic Walking Tour, Witch's Haunted Barn, River Park Concert
itineraries.theme: Historic Hillsborough by day, a family haunted barn and pumpkin patch at Firefly Farm, then a free all-day outdoor concert at River Park
itineraries.drive_time: About 40 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W / I-85 N; Firefly Farm (Hunt Rd) is a short drive from downtown Hillsborough (check your map)
itineraries.cost_range: Walking tour $10; Witch's Haunted Barn $13; Spooktacular and River Park concert free; about $35-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny, cool Saturday (54°F at 10 AM, about 65°F at 3 PM, 59°F at 7 PM). Take the 10:30 AM guided walking tour from the Hillsborough Visitors Center, have lunch, then drive out to Firefly Farm for the Witch's Haunted Barn and pumpkin patch. Families can stop at the free Halloween Spooktacular at Central Orange Recreation (1-4 PM). Spend late afternoon at the free River Park Concert (noon-8 PM) and walk two blocks to Nomad for dinner.

morning.title: Hillsborough Guided Walking Tours
morning.location: Hillsborough Visitors Center, 150 East King Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: 10:30 AM-12:30 PM. Guided walk through one of North Carolina's oldest towns (founded 1754). Tickets: https://www.zeffy.com/ticketing/3277bebb-5a4c-48ec-9a1e-0c4e287138b5

afternoon.title: 2026 Halloween Spooktacular! (optional, for kids)
afternoon.location: Central Orange Recreation, 302 West Tryon Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: 1-4 PM. Costume contest, pumpkin decorating, cakewalks, bingo, pumpkin hunt, inflatables. Info: https://www.orangecountync.gov/875/Halloween-Spooktacular. Go before or after the barn.

afternoon.title: The Witch's Haunted Barn
afternoon.location: Firefly Farm, 4911 Hunt Road, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: Open noon-7 PM. A whimsical, family-friendly haunted barn plus pumpkin patch. Tickets: https://www.fireflyfarmnc.com/hauntedbarn-pumpkinpatch

afternoon.title: 2026 River Park Concert
afternoon.location: River Park, 140 E. Margaret Lane, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: Runs noon-8 PM. Free outdoor show; per a Triangle on the Cheap listing the headliner is The Brothers Comatose. Info: https://www.visitchapelhill.org/event/2026-river-park-concert/35410/

food.notes: 228 S Churton St, Hillsborough, a few blocks from the Visitors Center. Own site: weekend food-bar breakfast 7 AM-noon. The food-bar page names no breakfast dishes or prices, so no vegan or vegetarian dish was verified.

236 S. Nash St, Hillsborough NC 27278. Own site: Wed-Sat 11:30 AM-9 PM. Its menu page shows no item text, so no vegan or vegetarian dish or price was verified. Alternative: the Weaver Street Market food bar (lunch from noon); its specials page lists Red Lentil Dal and Sesame Crunch Tofu, but they are not labeled vegan and are not dated.

122 W King St, Hillsborough NC 27278, a short walk from River Park. Own site: Saturday 4-10 PM (dinner only). Own menu: Chana Masala $19 (VG; adding chicken makes it non-vegan); Thai Cauliflower $13 (VG, with peanuts). The menu labels VG but not V; all VG dishes are also vegetarian. The site says items may vary.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, about 54°F at 10:30 AM. Wear a jacket.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (0%). If needed, visit the free 'THERE AND BACK' show at the Hillsborough Gallery of Arts (10 AM-6 PM, event 1fa403081dc6).

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, about 64°F at 5 PM, dropping to 59°F by 7 PM. Sunset is about 6:25 PM; bring a blanket and a layer.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, go straight to dinner at Nomad, which opens at 4 PM.

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 9:30 AM for the 10:30 AM tour (I-40 W to I-85 N, then Churton St into town).
Park once downtown for the tour, lunch, River Park and dinner. The Visitors Center (150 E King St), River Park (Margaret Ln) and Nomad (122 W King St) are within a few blocks of each other.
Firefly Farm needs a short drive. Buy barn tickets at https://www.fireflyfarmnc.com/hauntedbarn-pumpkinpatch.
Nomad opens at 4 PM; plan dinner around 5:30 PM, then return to River Park for the last sets.
Drive back to Raleigh takes about 40 min.

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill Saturday: Goatober Fest, Harvest Festival, Chapel Hill Ghost Walk
itineraries.theme: Farm fall day outside Chapel Hill (pumpkins with goats, a harvest festival with hayrides) followed by a guided ghost walk downtown
itineraries.drive_time: About 35 min from downtown Raleigh to Chapel Hill via I-40 W; Spring Haven Farm (Homer Ruffin Rd) and Sunrise Community Farm Center (Millhouse Rd) are each about 15-20 min from downtown Chapel Hill
itineraries.cost_range: Goatober Fest $13.95-$19.95; Harvest Festival $8-$45; ghost walk $14; about $40-$65 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny, cool Saturday (54°F at 10 AM, about 65°F at 3 PM, 56°F at 8 PM). Start with Goatober Fest at Spring Haven Farm (carving pumpkins with goats, tractor train). Lunch on Franklin Street, then go to the Sunrise Community Farm Center Harvest Festival for pumpkin carving, hayrides and carnival games. Have dinner at Kipos, then take the 8 PM Chapel Hill Ghost Walk from Rougarou on Henderson Street.

morning.title: Goatober Fest | Carving Pumpkins with Goats
morning.location: Spring Haven Farm, 5306 Homer Ruffin Road, Chapel Hill, NC 27516
morning.notes: 10 AM-noon (end time estimated). Farm animals, fall decorations, tractor train, pumpkin carving. Tickets: https://www.simpletix.com/e/goatober-fest-carving-pumpkins-with-goats-tickets-288348

afternoon.title: Harvest Festival 2026
afternoon.location: Sunrise Community Farm Center, 6407 Millhouse Road, Chapel Hill, NC 27516
afternoon.notes: 3-7 PM. Pumpkin carving, hayrides, carnival games, food, music, pony rides. The listing says a free bonfire and drum circle start at 7 PM. Register: https://www.sunrisecommunityfarmcenter.com/event-details-registration/harvest-festival-2026. Leave by about 5:45 PM for dinner.

evening.title: Chapel Hill Ghost Walk | Walking Tour
evening.location: Rougarou Cajun Kitchen (Imbibe), 108 Henderson Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
evening.notes: 8-9 PM. Guided walk through Chapel Hill legends: duels, figures from the past, pranksters from beyond. Book: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/booking-calendar/chapel-hill-ghost-walk?category=0fd7a45f-c9e7-4fde-8b77-b953462112a9&referral=service_list_widget

food.notes: 101 E Weaver St, Carrboro, on the way to Spring Haven Farm. Own site: Mon-Sat food-bar breakfast 7-11 AM. The page names no breakfast dishes or prices, so no vegan or vegetarian dish was verified.
410 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill NC 27516. Own site: open daily 11 AM-9 PM. Its menu page shows no items, so no vegan or vegetarian dish or price was verified; ask at the counter.

1800 E. Franklin St #16 (EastGate Crossing), Chapel Hill NC 27514, about 5 min by car from Henderson St. Own site: Saturday dinner 5-10 PM. Own dinner menu: Atzem $20 (yellow rice stewed in tomato sauce, zucchini, kale; labeled Vegan, GF); Olga's Handmade Spanakopita $13 (labeled Vegetarian). Book a 6:15 PM table.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, 54°F at 10 AM and about 65°F at 3 PM.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (0%). If needed, go to the Hallo-Day Fair By Daylight trick-or-treat market at 930 MLK Jr Blvd (11 AM-2 PM, free, event 6c54149d6d69), whose own description calls it an indoor market.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly clear, about 56°F at 8 PM. Bring a layer.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, see Wild Mind Improv's Halloween Spooktacular at the Carrboro ArtsCenter instead (6:15 PM, $15-$25, event 9f70ecaa35e7).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 9:15 AM for the 10 AM Goatober Fest (I-40 W, then west through Carrboro).
Book ahead: Goatober (simpletix), Harvest Festival (sunrisecommunityfarmcenter.com) and the ghost walk (trianglewalkingtours.com). Links are in each stop.
Downtown Chapel Hill has public decks and metered lots near Franklin and Rosemary Streets, a short walk from 108 Henderson St.
Drive back to Raleigh after the 9 PM finish takes about 35 min.

itineraries.title: Durham Sunday: Pumpkin Patch Express, Zine Machine Fest, Spooky Tales & Tasty Ales
itineraries.theme: A Durham Sunday: a train ride to the museum pumpkin patch, the state's largest printed-matter festival and a maker market around Durham Central Park, then ghost-story night at a downtown taproom
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 W / NC-147; all stops are within 10 min of downtown Durham
itineraries.cost_range: Pumpkin Patch Express $13.50-$16 (museum admission separate for non-members); Zine fest, market and Spooky Tales free; about $35-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny Sunday (51°F at 9 AM, about 66°F at 1 PM, 61°F at 7 PM). Brunch at Elmo's Diner on Ninth Street, then ride the Pumpkin Patch Express at the Museum of Life and Science. Midday, walk the Zine Machine Printed Matter Festival at the Durham Armory and the Durham Underground Market next door in Durham Central Park. After an early dinner at Luna, go to Spooky Tales & Tasty Ales at The Glass Jug Downtown for open-mic ghost stories.

morning.title: Pumpkin Patch Express
morning.location: Museum of Life and Science, 433 W. Murray Avenue, Durham, NC 27704
morning.notes: Timed train rides 9:30 AM-4:40 PM with a midday break; one pumpkin per ticketed guest. Museum admission is separate for non-members. Book a time: https://www.lifeandscience.org/explore/pumpkin-patch-express/

afternoon.title: ZINE MACHINE PRINTED MATTER FESTIVAL
afternoon.location: The Durham Armory, 212 Foster St, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 11 AM-5 PM. Over 75 vendors of zines, comics, prints and handmade books. Info: https://zinemachinefest.com/

afternoon.title: Durham Underground Market
afternoon.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster St, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 11 AM-3 PM. MAKRS Society market with 40+ local vendors, food trucks and live bands. A short walk up Foster St from the Armory. Info: https://durhamcentralpark.org/upcoming-event/durham-underground-market-2/2026-10-25/

evening.title: Spooky Tales & Tasty Ales
evening.location: The Glass Jug Downtown, 545 Foster St, Ste 10, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: 7-9 PM. Bring a ghost story to tell or just listen. Tickets (free): https://eventvesta.com/events/164330/t/tickets

food.vegetarian_dish: Santa Fe Breakfast Bowl (cornbread fritters, sweet potatoes, black beans, chilaquiles sauce, scrambled eggs, feta, avocado)
food.notes: 776 9th Street, Durham NC 27705, about 10 min from the museum. Own site: Sunday 7 AM-3:30 PM. Own site lists the Santa Fe Breakfast Bowl at $11 on the weekend brunch specials for Oct 19-25. Elmo's does not label dishes; this was classified from the listed ingredients. No vegan breakfast dish was found (items include eggs, cheese or cream).

food.place: Food trucks at the Durham Underground Market
food.notes: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster St. The market listing says food trucks will be there but does not name them. No vegan or vegetarian dish was verified.

food.vegan_dish: Chili Braised Jack Fruit (GF, V+), with choice of two sides
food.notes: 112 W Main St, Durham NC 27701, about 0.6 mi from The Glass Jug. Own site: Sunday 11 AM-9 PM. The food menu linked from Luna's site (titled Spring 2026): Chili Braised Jack Fruit $16 (V+), Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower $11 (V). Vegan sides include Black Beans & Coconut Rice and Sautéed Garlic Kale (V+). Eat around 5:30 PM.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, about 55°F at 10:30 AM. Book a morning train time.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast (0%). If needed, spend the time inside the Museum of Life and Science (admission separate).
No rain is forecast. If needed, go to the GRL Market at Durham Bottling Company, an indoor market (11 AM-3 PM, free, event 413cf902ee14).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by about 8:45 AM for a 9:30 AM brunch at Elmo's.
Pumpkin Patch Express uses timed tickets; book at https://www.lifeandscience.org/explore/pumpkin-patch-express/.

Park once near Durham Central Park (Foster St). The Armory (212 Foster), the park (501 Foster) and The Glass Jug (545 Foster) are within a few minutes' walk. Luna (112 W Main St) is a 12-min walk or short drive.
Drive back to Raleigh after 9 PM takes about 30 min.

itineraries.title: Apex Wednesday Evening: Spooky Tails at the Nature Park, Ghost Stories with Donna Washington
itineraries.theme: A weeknight Halloween outing in Apex: a dog-friendly meetup at Apex Nature Park, dinner on Salem Street, then storyteller Donna Washington's ghost stories at The Halle
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh to Apex via I-40 W / US-1 S; Apex Nature Park to downtown Apex is about 10 min
itineraries.cost_range: Spooky Tails free; ghost stories $12-$18 (kids show) or $15-$18 (adult show); about $15-$30 per person for dinner
itineraries.overview: An after-work outing on a warm, mostly sunny Wednesday (72°F at 5 PM; the night forecast is partly cloudy with a low near 51°F). Bring your dog to Spooky Tails at Apex Nature Park (5-7 PM). Eat on Salem Street in downtown Apex, then see Donna Washington's ghost stories at The Halle: the 6 PM 'A Little Shiver' kids show for families, or the 8:30 PM 'Of Blood and Bone' show for adults (18+).

afternoon.title: Spooky Tails
afternoon.location: Apex Nature Park, 2600 Evans Rd., Apex, NC 27502
afternoon.notes: 5-7 PM. Spooky-season meetup for dogs and owners, with vendors handing out treats and resources. Info: https://www.apexnc.org/Calendar.aspx?EID=4841&month=10&year=2026&day=28&calType=0

evening.title: "A Little Shiver" Kid's Show: Ghost Stories with Donna Washington (family option)
evening.location: The Halle Cultural Arts Center, 237 N. Salem St., Apex, NC 27502
evening.notes: 6-7:30 PM. Family show. If you take this one, leave Spooky Tails by 5:40 PM and eat after. Tickets: https://thehalle.org/Calendar.aspx?EID=4788&month=7&year=2026&day=19&calType=0

evening.title: "Of Blood and Bone": Ghost Stories with Donna Washington (adult option)
evening.location: The Halle Cultural Arts Center, 237 N. Salem St., Apex, NC 27502
evening.notes: 8:30-10 PM. Adults only (18+) per other listings of this show. Tickets: https://thehalle.org/Calendar.aspx?EID=4789&month=7&year=2026&day=19&calType=0

food.vegetarian_dish: Greek Salad (mixed greens, feta, Kalamata olives, cucumber, red onion, tomato, pepperoncini)
food.notes: 113 N. Salem St, Apex NC 27502, about a block from The Halle. Own site: Wednesday 11:30 AM-11 PM. Own menu: Greek Salad $9.99; burgers ($11.99) can swap in a veggie patty, whose ingredients are not listed. The menu has no V/VG labels, so dishes were classified from listed ingredients. No vegan dish was verified; ask staff. This is a weeknight evening plan, so breakfast and lunch are not included.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny and about 72°F at 5 PM. Sunset is about 6:20 PM.
alternatives.rain: Rain chance is low (2-6%). If needed, go to 'Haunted Carolina: The Spookiest Places in North Carolina' at Middle Creek Community Library (6:30 PM, free, event 9da4397843fc).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 4:25 PM for the 5 PM start (I-40 W to US-1 S).
Choose one Halle show: 6 PM kids show or 8:30 PM adult show. Both are in the same theater at 237 N. Salem St; book at thehalle.org (links in each stop).
Park once in downtown Apex near Salem St; the pub and The Halle are about a block apart.
Drive back to Raleigh after the 10 PM adult show takes about 30 min.
